62037-child-of-the-sun.title: Child Of The Sun
62037-child-of-the-sun.creator: Unknown
62037-child-of-the-sun.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. How had the Hiltonists traced him back from New York? Paul Avery, the Unregenerate recruit he went to get, had passed a rigid psycho-search--which, incidentally, revealed the finest brain ever to come to the Unregenerate cause. And he'd spoken to no one but Falken.

62642-war-prisoner-money-and-medals.title: War Prisoner Money And Medals
62642-war-prisoner-money-and-medals.creator: Guido Kisch
62642-war-prisoner-money-and-medals.description: A book by Guido Kisch. to the rising numbers of captives. The issuance of special currency for the exclusive use of war prisoners is therefore an act of national defense in wartime. The use of this special type of money, for which both paper and metal are employed, is restricted in a twofold way. Its circulation is limited to war prisoners, and—even more strictly—to definite internment camps.

arxiv-2102-08588.title: NODE-SELECT: A Graph Neural Network Based On A Selective Propagation Technique
arxiv-2102-08588.creator: Steph-Yves Louis, Alireza Nasiri, Fatima J. Rolland, Cameron Mitro, Jianjun Hu
arxiv-2102-08588.description: Abstract While there exists a wide variety of graph neural networks (GNN) for node classification, only a minority of them adopt mechanisms that effectively target noise propagation during the message-passing procedure. Additionally, a very important challenge that significantly affects graph neural networks is the issue of scalability which limits their application to larger graphs.

arxiv-2209-04474.title: Multi-system measurements in generalized probabilistic theories and their role in information processing
arxiv-2209-04474.creator: Giorgos Eftaxias, Mirjam Weilenmann, Roger Colbeck
arxiv-2209-04474.description: Abstract Generalized probabilistic theories (GPTs) provide a framework in which a range of possible theories can be examined, including classical theory, quantum theory and those beyond. In general, enlarging the state space of a GPT leads to fewer possible measurements because the additional states give stronger constraints on the set of effects, the constituents of measurements.

arxiv-2212-05068.title: Hofstadter states and reentrant charge order in a semiconductor moiré lattice
arxiv-2212-05068.creator: Carlos R. Kometter, Jiachen Yu, Trithep Devakul, Aidan P. Reddy, Yang Zhang, Benjamin A. Foutty, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Liang Fu, Benjamin E. Feldman
arxiv-2212-05068.description: Abstract The emergence of moiré materials with flat bands provides a platform to systematically investigate and precisely control correlated electronic phases. Here, we report local electronic compressibility measurements of a twisted WSe 2 /MoSe 2 heterobilayer which reveal a rich phase diagram of interpenetrating Hofstadter states and electron solids.

arxiv-2304-03839.title: Characterisation of the upper atmospheres of HAT-P-32 b, WASP-69 b, GJ 1214 b, and WASP-76 b through their He i triplet absorption
arxiv-2304-03839.creator: M. Lampón, M. López-Puertas, J. Sanz-Forcada, S. Czesla, L. Nortmann, N. Casasayas-Barris, J. Orell-Miquel, A. Sánchez-López, C. Danielski, E. Pallé, K. Molaverdikhani, Th. Henning, J. A. Caballero, P. J. Amado, A. Quirrenbach, A. Reiners, and I. Ribas
arxiv-2304-03839.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by M. Lampón, M. López-Puertas, J. Sanz-Forcada, S. Czesla, L. Nortmann, N. Casasayas-Barris, J. Orell-Miquel, A. Sánchez-López, C. Danielski, E. Pallé, K. Molaverdikhani, Th. Henning, J. A. Caballero, P. J. Amado, A. Quirrenbach, A. Reiners, and I. Ribas. Characterisation of atmospheres undergoing photo-evaporation is key to understanding the formation, evolution, and diversity of planets. However, only a few upper atmospheres that experience this kind of hydrodynamic escape have been characterised.

arxiv-2309-12771.title: Vertex number of the typical cell in a tri-directional Poisson line tessellation
arxiv-2309-12771.creator: Nils Heerten, Janina Hübner, Christoph Thäle
arxiv-2309-12771.description: Abstract This paper deals with the typical cell in a Poisson line tessellation in the plane whose directional distribution is concentrated on three equally spread values with possibly different weights. Such a random polygon can only be a triangle, a quadrilateral, a pentagon or a hexagon.

arxiv-2401-12291.title: Cosmography of the Local Universe by Multipole Analysis of the Expansion Rate Fluctuation Field
arxiv-2401-12291.creator: Basheer Kalbouneh, Christian Marinoni, Roy Maartens
arxiv-2401-12291.description: Abstract We establish a relationship between the multipoles of the expansion rate fluctuation field η , \eta, which capture in an accurate way deviations from isotropy in the redshift-distance relation, and the multipoles of the covariant cosmographic parameters —Hubble ℍ o \mathbb{H}_{o} , deceleration ℚ o \mathbb{Q}_{o} , jerk 𝕁 o \mathbb{J}_{o} , and curvature ℝ o \mathbb{R}_{o} .

arxiv-2402-18588.title: Non Linear Hall Effects induced by Berry Curvature Dipole in CuPb 9 (PO 4 ) 6 O
arxiv-2402-18588.creator: Bishnu Karki, Kai Chen, Pavan Hosur
arxiv-2402-18588.description: Abstract The nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE), an emergent response in systems with broken inversion symmetry, provides a powerful tool for probing topological transport properties. In this context, we investigate copper-substituted lead apatite (LK-99), a material that initially garnered attention for its controversial claim of room-temperature superconductivity.

arxiv-2411-13350.title: Learning based Ge’ez character handwritten recognition This study was carried out within the PNRR research activities of the consortium iNEST (Interconnected North-Est Innovation Ecosystem) funded by the European Union Next-GenerationEU (Piano Nazionale di Ripresa e Resilienza (PNRR) – Missione 4 Co
arxiv-2411-13350.creator: Hailemicael Lulseged Yimer, Hailegabriel Dereje Degefa, Marco Cristani, Federico Cunico
arxiv-2411-13350.description: Abstract Ge’ez, an ancient Ethiopic script of cultural and historical significance, has been largely neglected in handwriting recognition research, hindering the digitization of valuable manuscripts. Our study addresses this gap by developing a state-of-the-art Ge’ez handwriting recognition system using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. Our approach uses a two-stage recognition process.

arxiv-2502-03413.title: Polarization entanglement and qubit error rate dependence on the exciton-phonon coupling in self-assembled quantum dots
arxiv-2502-03413.creator: Urmimala Dewan, Parvendra Kumar, Amarendra K. Sarma 1,
arxiv-2502-03413.description: Abstract Polarization-entangled photons are the key ingredients of various protocols in quantum computation and quantum key distribution. A near-unity degree of polarization entanglement is essential to minimize qubit error rates in key distribution. This study theoretically investigates the polarization-entangled photon pairs produced by a quantum-dot radiative cascade located within a micropillar cavity.

arxiv-2509-19888.title: An Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers for Topology Optimization
arxiv-2509-19888.creator: Harsh Choudhary, Sven Leyffer, Dominic Yang
arxiv-2509-19888.description: Abstract We consider a class of integer-constrained optimization problems governed by partial differential equation (PDE) constraints and regularized via total variation (TV) in the context of topology optimization. The presence of discrete design variables, nonsmooth regularization, and non-convex objective renders the problem computationally challenging.

arxiv-2602-18472.title: Physiologically Informed Deep Learning: A Multi-Scale Framework for Next-Generation PBPK Modeling
arxiv-2602-18472.creator: Shunqi Liu, Han Qiu, Tong Wang
arxiv-2602-18472.description: Abstract Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling is a cornerstone of model-informed drug development (MIDD), providing a mechanistic framework to predict drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME). Despite its utility, adoption is hindered by high computational costs for large-scale simulations, difficulty in parameter identification for complex biological systems, and uncertainty in interspecies extrapolation.

pmc-10597203.title: Pediatric injuries classification using openAI: new opportunities for epidemiological surveillance
pmc-10597203.creator: G Lorenzoni, V Sciannameo, G A Baldan, S Bressan, L Da Dalt, P Berchialla
pmc-10597203.description: BackgroundThe burden of unintentional pediatric injuries remains a significant concern for healthcare systems worldwide. Timely and accurate surveillance is critical for injury prevention and resource allocation. However, the diagnosis reported in the emergency department records is often not coded, and the manual coding of these records is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to errors.

pmc-10613611.title: Massage manipulation and progression of osteosarcoma, does it really correlate: a combination of prospective and retrospective cohort study
pmc-10613611.creator: I Wayan Arya Mahendra Karda, Wan Faisham Wan Ismail, Achmad Fauzi Kamal
pmc-10613611.description: In Indonesia, the challenge of osteosarcoma progression is further worsened by patients' dependence on traditional massage therapy, low socio-economy, and educational status. This study aims to analyze the differences in the characteristics, laboratory findings, surgery techniques, degree of histopathological necrosis, and metastasis between osteosarcoma patients with and without prior massage manipulation therapy.

pmc-10618265.title: Continually recruited naïve T cells contribute to the follicular helper and regulatory T cell pools in germinal centers
pmc-10618265.creator: Julia Merkenschlager, Riza-Maria Berz, Victor Ramos, Maximilian Uhlig, Andrew J MacLean, Carla R Nowosad, Thiago Y Oliveira, Michel C Nussenzweig
pmc-10618265.description: Follicular helper T cells (TFH) mediate B cell selection and clonal expansion in germinal centers (GCs), and follicular regulatory T cells (TFR) prevent the emergence of self-reactive B cells and help to extinguish the reaction. Here we show that GC reactions continually recruit T cells from both the naïve conventional and naive thymic regulatory T cell (Treg) repertoires.

pmc-11313925.title: Enhancing Solanum lycopersicum Resilience: Bacterial Cellulose Alleviates Low Irrigation Stress and Boosts Nutrient Uptake
pmc-11313925.creator: Noelia De la Cruz Gómez, César Poza-Carrión, Lucía Del Castillo-González, Ángel Isidro Martínez Sánchez, Ana Moliner, Inmaculada Aranaz, Marta Berrocal-Lobo
pmc-11313925.description: The use of natural-origin biomaterials in bioengineering has led to innovative approaches in agroforestry. Bacterial cellulose (BC), sharing the same chemical formula as plant-origin cellulose (PC), exhibits significantly different biochemical properties, including a high degree of crystallinity and superior water retention capacity. Previous research showed that natural-origin glucose-based chitin enhanced plant growth in both herbaceous and non-herbaceous plants.

pmc-11418868.title: Methadone Initiation in the Emergency Department for Opioid Use Disorder
pmc-11418868.creator: Daniel Wolfson, Roz King, Miles Lamberson, Jackson Lyttleton, Colin T Waters, Samantha H Schneider, Blake A Porter, Kyle M DeWitt, Peter Jackson, Martha W Stevens, John Brooklyn, Richard Rawson, Elly Riser
pmc-11418868.description: IntroductionOverdose deaths from high-potency synthetic opioids, including fentanyl and its analogs, continue to rise along with emergency department (ED) visits for complications of opioid use disorder (OUD). Fentanyl accumulates in adipose tissue; although rare, this increases the risk of precipitated withdrawal in patients upon buprenorphine initiation. Many EDs have implemented medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) programs using buprenorphine.

pmc-11529863.title: Contrasting and combining transcriptome complexity captured by short and long RNA sequencing reads
pmc-11529863.creator: Seong Woo Han, San Jewell, Andrei Thomas-Tikhonenko, Yoseph Barash
pmc-11529863.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Mapping transcriptomic variations using either short- or long-read RNA sequencing is a staple of genomic research. Long reads are able to capture entire isoforms and overcome repetitive regions, whereas short reads still provide improved coverage and error rates. Yet, open questions remain, such as how to quantitatively compare the technologies, can we combine them, and what is the benefit of such a combined view?

pmc-11532971.title: Identifying adeno‐associated virus (AAV) vectors that efficiently target high grade glioma cells, for in vitro monitoring of temporal cell responses
pmc-11532971.creator: Farhana A. Sarker, Yuyan Chen, Adrian Westhaus, Leszek Lisowski, Geraldine M. O'Neill
pmc-11532971.description: To improve the translation of preclinical cancer research data to successful clinical effect, there is an increasing focus on the use of primary patient‐derived cancer cells with limited growth in culture to reduce genetic and phenotype drift. However, these primary lines are less amenable to standardly used methods of exogenous DNA introduction.

pmc-11547548.title: Optimal Geometry for Focused Ion Beam-Milled Samples for Direct-Pull Micro-Tensile Testing Performed In Situ in a Scanning Electron Microscope
pmc-11547548.creator: Daniel B. Yin, Haiping Sun, Amit Misra
pmc-11547548.description: A thorough procedure was developed to efficiently manufacture dogbone samples using focused ion beam (FIB) milling for micro-tensile testing. A Bruker PI 89 PicoIndenter, Billerica, MA, USA, was used as a case study, although the analysis and results are applicable to other micro-mechanical testing systems capable of mounting a standard, Ø12.7 mm × Ø3.

pmc-11653539.title: Intraoperative virtual reality for older patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty: study protocol for a randomized clinical trial
pmc-11653539.creator: Juan P Espinosa-Leon, Ryan Mathura, Guanqing Chen, Melisa Joseph, Trishna Sadhwani, Najla Beydoun, Edjay R Hernandez, Tyler Riley, Lisa J Kunze, Valerie Goodspeed, Brian P O’Gara
pmc-11653539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn an aging surgical patient population, preventing complications such as oversedation has taken increasing priority in perioperative care. Intraoperative use of virtual reality (VR) may decrease sedative requirements. We hypothesize that the use of immersive VR during total knee arthroplasty (TKA) will lead to decreased propofol requirements, improved patient-reported satisfaction, and reduced postoperative opioid requirements compared to active and usual care controls.MethodsThis is a single-center, randomized clinical trial of older (age > 60) patients undergoing TKA.

pmc-12446129.title: Optimization and validation of a linear appraisal system for zoometric traits in dromedary camels
pmc-12446129.creator: Carlos Iglesias Pastrana, Francisco Javier Navas González, Elena Ciani, José Manuel León Jurado, Juan Vicente Delgado Bermejo
pmc-12446129.description: Linear appraisal scales focus on the qualitative assessment of specific traits along a standardized scale across animal populations. By minimizing errors and optimizing measurement procedures, these scales streamline resource allocation, saving time and costs for livestock managers and breeders, thereby facilitating informed breeding decisions and promoting genetic progress.

pmc-12485436.title: Perspectives of the new horizon in bone regeneration with standardized, centrally manufactured freeze-dried platelet-rich plasma
pmc-12485436.creator: Yi-Tzu Chen, Pei-Yin Chen, Yu-Chao Chang
pmc-12485436.description: omising clinical outcomes.1,2 Recently, the preparation of PRF has been modified as many flowable variants, such as liquid fibrinogen, with enhanced clinical application by enabling the creation of cohesive “sticky bone” for superior graft stability.3 Despite these advances, the lack of standardization remains a fundamental challenge.

pmc-12486345.title: Unsupervised Clustering Reveals Intestine‐Adapted Eosinophil Subsets Shaped by Local Inflammation
pmc-12486345.creator: Leigha D Larsen, Arman Kian, Natalie A Falta, Barbara Fox, Lisa A Spencer
pmc-12486345.description: ettings.S1 Extra‐physiologic infiltration of eosinophils is a diagnostic criterion of eosinophilic gastrointestinal disorders (EGIDs; eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE), enteritis (EoN), and colitis (EoC)) and a common characteristic of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD; Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis). Although generally considered pathologic in EGIDs and IBD, contributions of eosinophils to the pathophysiology of either condition remain incompletely understood.

pmc-12542229.title: CT-derived proximal tibial bone density imbalance is associated with knee osteoarthritis
pmc-12542229.creator: Hogyeong Kang, Geonil Kim, Sungjoon Lim, Soonchul Lee
pmc-12542229.description: BackgroundCompartmental imbalance in proximal tibial bone density may contribute to the structural progression of knee osteoarthritis (OA), yet remains underexplored using quantitative imaging. This study investigated the association between compartmental proximal tibial bone density, measured using CT-derived Hounsfield units (HU), and knee OA.

pmc-12554936.title: Balancing empathy and rationality (raso jo pareso): A cultural lens on gender and palliative care
pmc-12554936.creator: Triyono Triyono, Rahmi Dwi Febriani, Randi Saputra, Rizky Andana Pohan
pmc-12554936.description: ace of death, the qualitative findings highlighted significant gendered dynamics in caregiving and support. Women were disproportionately expected to assume caregiving roles, while men often hesitated to accept help due to norms of masculinity and stoicism. When contextualized within Minangkabau culture, a society in West Sumatra, Indonesia, with a matrilineal kinship system, these findings invite deeper reflection.

pmc-12699897.title: Social support and psychological distress among family caregivers of palliative patients at two rural hospitals in Malawi: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12699897.creator: Ian Matandika, Modai Mnenula, Prosper Lutala
pmc-12699897.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCaring for palliative patients imposes a significant burden, as caregivers must provide physical, psychological, social, and spiritual support. Identifying ways to support informal caregivers is essential for improving their quality of life as well as that of the patients.

pmc-13182695.title: Quantitative myocardial hypoperfusion on coronary CTA: correlation with left atrial and left ventricular functional parameters
pmc-13182695.creator: Safiye Sanem Dereli Bulut, Sevde Nur Emir
pmc-13182695.description: PurposeTo investigate the association between myocardial hypodensity on standard coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) and echocardiographic diastolic dysfunction (DD) grade, and to evaluate correlations between hypodensity percentage and CT-derived left atrium (LA) and left ventricular (LV) functional parameters.Material and methodsThis retrospective study included 156 patients (mean age 47.9 ± 11.

pmc-13239267.title: Unveiling the Link Between COVID‐19 and Pulmonary Hypertension
pmc-13239267.creator: Jad Abdul Khalek, Mohamad Al Hajjar, Zeina Al-Khalil, Jana Salem, Rana Zareef, Fadi Bitar, Mariam Arabi
pmc-13239267.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThe COVID‐19 pandemic, caused by the SARS‐CoV‐2 virus, was first identified in Wuhan, China, in December 2019 and has had a significant impact on global health. The virus uncovered multifaceted complications across various organ systems, including the cardiovascular system.

pmc-13243473.title: Influence of graphene oxide (GO) on thermo-mechanical performance of fly ash-steel slag based geopolymer composite: an experimental and numerical approach
pmc-13243473.creator: Ranjit Singh, Ashwin Raut, Supriya Janga, Adeolu Adediran, Shaswat Kumar Das
pmc-13243473.description: This study demonstrates the feasibility of incorporating graphene oxide (GO) as an additive to enhance the mechanical and thermal properties of fly ash (FA) and steel slag (SS)-based geopolymer composites. A series of experiments and numerical simulations was conducted to evaluate the effect of GO on the material’s thermo-mechanical behaviour.

pmc-13381065.title: Two Genetically Distinct Lineages in Galician Populations of the Three‐Spined Stickleback (Gasterosteus aculeatus)
pmc-13381065.creator: Yo Y. Yamasaki, Yu Endo, Naomi Musto, Juan Galindo, Alberto Velando, Sin‐Yeon Kim, Atsushi J. Nagano, Asano Ishikawa, Jun Kitano
pmc-13381065.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The three‐spined stickleback ( Gasterosteus aculeatus ) is a widely used model for studying the genetic basis of phenotypic variation. However, genomic studies have focused primarily on a limited number of geographic regions, leaving some regions underrepresented. In this study, we investigated genetic variation in stickleback populations from Galicia in northwestern Spain, a region near the southern limit of the species' European distribution that has been proposed as a glacial refugium but remains underrepresented in genomic analyses.

pmc-13423143.title: Extending the age limit of paediatric care for young people from refugee backgrounds

pmc-13444399.title: Ac‐SDKP modulates apoptosis via HSP27 and the FAS/FASL and mitochondrial axes
pmc-13444399.creator: Wenxin Guo, Jinyin Yan, Wenli Li, Jin Wang, Lu Liu, Chengmei Zhang, Wei Cao, Shanshan Yao, Haibo Gong, Yi He, Zihan Zhou, Siyan Chen, Li Feng, Haijing Deng
pmc-13444399.description: BackgroundSilicosis is a progressive, irreversible fibrotic lung disease caused by long‐term exposure to crystalline silica. Although the anti‐fibrotic tetrapeptide Ac‐SDKP has shown promise in reducing fibrosis, the specific molecular mechanisms through which it modulates apoptosis in silica‐induced lung injury remain unclear, particularly the role of heat shock protein 27 (HSP27).

pmc-13586053.title: Corneal Sequestration and Bilateral Distichiasis in a Binturong (Arctictis binturong)
pmc-13586053.creator: Vienna Lunking, Mandy Womble, Hannah L Smith, Ashley Souza, Sarah Ozawa, Tara Harrison, Elizabeth Rose, Annie Oh
pmc-13586053.description: ObjectiveTo report the first documented case of corneal sequestration and distichiasis in a binturong ( Arctictis binturong ), discuss implications of disease prevalence in a non‐domestic feliform, and hypothesize on potential etiology and predisposing factors for corneal sequestration.Animal StudiedA 15‐year‐old intact male binturong.ProceduresAnesthetized physical examination and ophthalmic assessment were performed by board‐certified specialists.
